title: TRON: A Digital Frontier
description: Adds TRON to the world of Minecraft. Battle in Disc Wars and lightcycle battles!
body:
Adds multiple items from TRON, including lightcycles and identity discs along with lightsuits with modifiable color!

This is a WIP, and this first release will not have much content, but it does work for the most part!

If it gets enough downloads I'll work on it more.

Please feel free to report bugs in the Discord!
